text: For an explicit finite-difference scheme for the wave equation, the CFL condition requires that:
choices: the time step be made as large as possible for efficiency
the numerical domain of dependence contain the physical one, i.e. c*dt/dx <= 1
explanation: The Courant-Friedrichs-Lewy condition c*dt/dx <= 1 requires the numerical domain of dependence to include the physical domain of dependence; otherwise the explicit scheme is unstable no matter how accurate. Von Neumann analysis makes this precise through Fourier modes.
